title: Plastids — Seminar Questions and Answers
description: Simple, interactive questions on Plastids designed for seminar Q&A and audience participation.

questions.question: In which organisms are plastids found?
questions.answer: Plastids are found in all plant cells and in euglenoids.

questions.question: Why are plastids easily visible under a light microscope?
questions.answer: Because they are relatively large in size.

questions.question: Based on the types of pigments they contain, into which three categories are plastids classified?
Which green pigment found in chloroplasts is responsible for trapping light energy for photosynthesis?
Which type of plastids impart yellow, orange, or red color to flowers and fruits?
Which group of fat-soluble pigments gives chromoplasts their yellow, orange, or red color?
questions.answer: Carotenoid pigments (such as carotene and xanthophylls).

questions.question: What are leucoplasts?
questions.answer: They are colourless plastids that store nutrients.

How many chloroplasts are present per cell in the green alga Chlamydomonas?
How many membranes enclose a chloroplast?

What is the semi-fluid space enclosed by the inner membrane of a chloroplast called?
What are the organized, flattened membranous sacs present within the stroma called?
